product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Bonded Leather Swivel Chair, 23.6"W, Brown
product.description: While this mid-century-design swivel chair is ideal for a home office, it's handsome enough to be used in any room. Brown upholstered bonded leather and low-slung arms offer comfort and durability. 23.6"W x 25.4"D x 30.5"H Upholstered soft, bonded leather over a solid wood frame; foam padding; solid wood legs with walnut finish The mid-century-inspired design of this chair features an opening in the back and low-slung arms. This attractive chair is suitable for any room where stylish extra seating is needed. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
